meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂工作拆成多个环节,派给多个助手并行执行并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务太重,想拆给多个 AI 助手分头做完再统一汇总。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task is too big to do alone and you want several assistants to split it and report back.

howto.what: Claude 会先判断本会话该用哪个 Orca 可执行文件（orca-ide、orca-dev、orca 等），再向该二进制索取与版本匹配的编排指南，然后按指南协调多个 Orca worker。这个技能文件本身只是发现入口，具体用法由二进制提供。
howto.when: 当你要做结构化的多智能体协调时触发：线程消息、任务派发、任务 DAG 等，或需要等待 worker_done 与升级结果时。

say.text: 加载 orchestration 的版本匹配指南
say.note: 会打印当前二进制对应的编排指南

say.text: 把这件事拆成任务 DAG 派发给 worker
say.note: 按指南协调多个 worker 执行

say.text: 等待 worker_done 或升级结果
say.note: 阻塞等待各 worker 回报

howto.what_en: Claude first resolves which Orca executable to use this session (orca-ide, orca-dev, orca), asks that binary for the version-matched orchestration guide, then coordinates Orca workers as the guide describes. The skill file itself is only a discovery stub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, task dispatch, task DAGs, and similar, or when waiting on worker_done and escalation results.

say_en.note: Prints the guide for your Orca binary

say_en.text: Split this into a task DAG and dispatch it to workers
